## 实验功能：HTTP/HTTPS STRM

Mova 新增实验性的 HTTP/HTTPS `.strm` 支持。媒体库可以识别内容为单个 HTTP 或 HTTPS 直连地址的 `.strm` 文件，并通过 Mova 的安全代理播放。

当前仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 直接媒体资源，不支持 RTSP、MMS、HLS/M3U8、需要自定义请求头或 Cookie 的资源，也不提供远程转码。该能力仍处于实验阶段，行为与配置可能继续调整。

如遇到扫描、匹配、拖动播放或兼容性问题，欢迎通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/issues) 或 [Telegram](https://t.me/mova_feedback) 反馈。

数据库迁移 `0004` 会在启动时自动原地执行，无需重建数据库或缓存。升级后请重新扫描包含 `.strm` 的媒体库；已有本地媒体无需重扫。

---

## Experimental: HTTP/HTTPS STRM

Mova now provides experimental support for `.strm` files containing one direct HTTP or HTTPS media URL. Playback is proxied through Mova with the STRM security policy applied.

This preview supports direct HTTP/HTTPS media resources only. It does not support RTSP, MMS, HLS/M3U8, custom request headers or cookies, or remote transcoding. The behavior and configuration may continue to change while the feature remains experimental.

Please report scanning, matching, seeking, or compatibility problems through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/issues) or [Telegram](https://t.me/mova_feedback).

Database migration `0004` runs automatically at startup. No database or cache rebuild is required. Rescan libraries containing `.strm` files after upgrading; existing local media does not need to be rescanned.
